neighbours.label: a chemical or isotope token just before the hyphen of a technical compound name (14C-, COOH-), where a hyphen is expected next
fire: Subjects received a single dose of 14C-labelled caffeine by mouth.
Self-assembled films with COOH-terminated chains were grown on silver.
The tracer 13C-acetate was infused over a period of two hours.
Binding was measured on COOH-functionalised beads in a salt buffer.
Rats were fed 14C-glucose and their breath was then sampled.
A solution of 13C-enriched urea was added to each of the wells.
The team coated the plate with a COOH-rich polymer before washing.
Liver uptake of 14C-acetate was far higher in the treated group.
quiet: Subjects received a single dose of plain caffeine by mouth.
Self-assembled films with long carbon chains were grown on silver.
The tracer was infused slowly over a period of two hours.
Binding was measured on coated plastic beads in a salt buffer.
Rats were fed ordinary glucose and their breath was then sampled.
A solution of purified urea was added to each of the wells.
The team coated the plate with a thin polymer before washing.
Liver uptake of the tracer was far higher in the treated group.

notes: Output direction: the + pole suppresses hyphen tokens, so this pole promotes them. Also fires on ' York' in 'New York at ...' and on code namespaces like 'members:', which this label leaves out. Fe-S and C-terminal did not fire.
